tagline.en: The Highline — the northernmost road across the country
tagline.zh: 「高线」——全美最靠北的横贯公路

start.zh: 华盛顿州埃弗里特，与 I-5 相接（西段）

end.zh: 缅因州霍尔顿，与 I-95 相接（东段）

en: US 2 is the northernmost east–west U.S. Route, and it comes in two pieces that have never been joined. The western segment runs from Everett, Washington, across the top of the country to St. Ignace, Michigan. The eastern segment begins again at Rouses Point, New York, and crosses northern Vermont, a corner of New Hampshire and the width of Maine. The gap is not damage done by an Interstate; the 1926 plan drew the route this way, with Canada in between.

For most of its western length it shadows the old Great Northern Railway across the northern plains, and it borrowed the railway's nickname: the Highline. Montana carries more of it than any other state. It crosses the Cascades at Stevens Pass, skirts the southern edge of Glacier National Park, runs out across Montana's and North Dakota's grain country, touches Lake Superior at Duluth and follows the north shore of Lake Michigan through the Upper Peninsula. The eastern segment is an entirely different road — a two-lane New England highway through Burlington, the White Mountains and the Maine woods.
zh: US 2 是最靠北的东西向美国国道，而且分成从未接通的两段。西段自华盛顿州埃弗里特起，横越国境北缘，抵达密歇根州圣伊格纳斯。东段则在纽约州劳斯波因特重新开始，穿过佛蒙特州北部、新罕布什尔州一角和缅因州全境。中间的断口并非州际公路造成的破坏：1926 年的方案本就如此划定，中间隔着加拿大。
西段大部分路程沿旧大北方铁路横穿北部平原，并沿用了铁路的绰号——「高线」。在各州之中，蒙大拿州境内的里程最长。它在史蒂文斯山口翻越喀斯喀特山脉，掠过冰川国家公园南缘，横穿蒙大拿与北达科他的产粮区，在德卢斯与苏必利尔湖相接，又沿密歇根湖北岸穿过上半岛。东段则完全是另一条路：一条双车道的新英格兰公路，途经伯灵顿、白山山脉和缅因州的林地。

en: The route's defining piece of geography is Marias Pass, on the southern boundary of Glacier National Park, where US 2 and the BNSF main line cross the Continental Divide side by side. It is the lowest crossing of the Divide between Canada and central New Mexico, which is why both the railway and the highway are there, and it is the northernmost pass in the United States kept open to cars all year.

It was also the hardest part to build. Marias Pass was the last section of the Theodore Roosevelt International Highway — US 2's named predecessor — to be completed; until 1930 motorists were carried through the park on flatcars behind Great Northern locomotives. On the plains the engineering problem was the opposite one, of scale rather than gradient: North Dakota has four-laned nearly the whole of its section, and when the state widened the road at Rugby in 1971 the monument marking the designated geographical centre of North America had to be picked up and moved.
zh: 这条路线在地理上最具决定性的一处是玛丽亚斯山口，位于冰川国家公园南界，US 2 与 BNSF 铁路干线在此并肩翻越大陆分水岭。它是加拿大与新墨西哥州中部之间分水岭最低的一处越岭点——铁路与公路选在这里正是因为如此——也是美国最北的、全年对汽车开放的山口。
它同时也是最难修的一段。玛丽亚斯山口是 US 2 的命名前身「西奥多·罗斯福国际公路」最后建成的路段；直到 1930 年，驾车者都还要把车装上平板车，由大北方铁路的机车拉着穿过园区。到了平原上，工程难题反了过来，是规模而非坡度：北达科他州几乎把境内全线拓宽为四车道；1971 年该州在拉格比拓宽道路时，标示北美地理中心的纪念碑不得不整体搬迁。

en: The predecessor was the Theodore Roosevelt International Highway, organised in February 1919 to link Portland, Maine, with Portland, Oregon, and named for the president who had died the month before. Its route crossed into Canada twice, and when the Joint Board on Interstate Highways broke the named trails up in 1925 the trail was divided among several numbers. By far the longest share went to US 2, between St. Ignace and Bonners Ferry, Idaho.

One late change stuck: in the 1925 draft, US 2 took the coastal route through Maine to Calais while US 1 went inland via Bangor. By the time the system was approved on 11 November 1926 the two had been swapped, giving US 2 the inland line to Houlton it still follows.

The western end moved much later. In 1946 US 2 was extended from Bonners Ferry over the former US 10A through Spokane and Stevens Pass to Everett, reaching Puget Sound for the first time. At the other end of the western segment, Michigan pulled the designation off the I-75 freeway in 1983 and cut it back to St. Ignace, where it now stops just north of the Mackinac Bridge.
zh: 它的前身是西奥多·罗斯福国际公路，1919 年 2 月组织成立，旨在连接缅因州波特兰与俄勒冈州波特兰，并以上个月刚去世的这位总统命名。该线路两度进入加拿大境内；1925 年州际公路联合委员会把各条命名汽车道拆分编号时，这条汽车道被分给了若干个号码，其中最长的一份给了 US 2——从圣伊格纳斯到爱达荷州邦纳斯费里。
有一处后期改动保留了下来：在 1925 年草案中，US 2 取道缅因州沿海线至卡莱斯，而 US 1 经班戈走内陆。到 1926 年 11 月 11 日方案通过时，两者已经对调，US 2 由此得到至今仍在沿用的、通往霍尔顿的内陆线。
西端的变动要晚得多。1946 年，US 2 自邦纳斯费里沿原 US 10A 经斯波坎与史蒂文斯山口延伸至埃弗里特，首次抵达普吉特湾。在西段的另一头，密歇根州于 1983 年把该编号从 I-75 高速公路上撤下，截短至圣伊格纳斯，如今它就停在麦基诺大桥以北不远处。

why.en: No figure exists. US 2 was numbered in 1926 along roads that were already open, and the two segments have been rebuilt independently by eleven states over a century. Construction accounting was done by state and by project, never by route.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。US 2 于 1926 年沿已通车的道路编号，此后两段由 11 个州历经一个世纪各自改建。造价核算按州、按工程进行，从未按路线统计。

why.en: No authoritative current figure exists. AASHTO leaves U.S. Route mileage to the states and last issued a national route log in 1989; published totals for US 2 also differ over whether to add the two segments together at all.
why.zh: 目前没有权威数据。AASHTO 把美国国道的里程统计交由各州负责，最后一份全国路线里程表发布于 1989 年；此外，各方公布的 US 2 总里程在「两段是否应相加」这一点上本身就不一致。

why.en: Traffic is counted per segment by each state DOT. On this route the range is extreme — suburban Everett and Spokane at one end of the scale, stretches of the Montana Highline that go for miles without a junction at the other — and no agency publishes a combined figure.
why.zh: 交通量由各州交通部门按路段统计。本路线的差距极大：一端是埃弗里特和斯波坎的郊区路段，另一端是蒙大拿「高线」上数英里不见一个路口的路段，没有任何机构发布合并统计数字。

value.en: 5,216 feet — the lowest crossing of the Continental Divide between Canada and central New Mexico, and the northernmost U.S. pass open to cars year round
value.zh: 海拔 5,216 英尺——是加拿大与新墨西哥州中部之间大陆分水岭最低的越岭点，也是美国最北的全年对汽车开放的山口

timeline.en: The Theodore Roosevelt International Highway is organised in February to link Portland, Maine, with Portland, Oregon.
timeline.zh: 2 月，西奥多·罗斯福国际公路组织成立，旨在连接缅因州波特兰与俄勒冈州波特兰。

timeline.en: US 2 is numbered on 11 November, in two segments separated by Canada.
timeline.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 2 获得编号，分为被加拿大隔开的两段。

timeline.en: The Marias Pass road is finished; motorists no longer have to be carried through Glacier by rail.
timeline.zh: 玛丽亚斯山口公路建成，驾车者不必再靠铁路载运穿过冰川国家公园。

timeline.en: The western end is extended from Bonners Ferry, Idaho, to Everett, Washington.
timeline.zh: 西端自爱达荷州邦纳斯费里延伸至华盛顿州埃弗里特。

timeline.en: Michigan truncates the route to St. Ignace, removing it from the I-75 freeway.
timeline.zh: 密歇根州将本路线截短至圣伊格纳斯，使其退出 I-75 高速公路。
